question: ​A sum amounts to Rs. 4,260 in 5 years at the rate of 4% p.a. simple interest. What will be the simple interest (in Rs. nearest to a Rs.) on the same sum for 4(1)/(5) years at the rate of 8(1)/(2)% p.a.?
solution:
**Given:**

A sum amounts to Rs. 4,260 in 5 years at the rate of 4% p.a. simple interest.

The same sum for 4(1)/(5) years at the rate of 8(1)/(2)% p.a.

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + S.I

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time and S.I = Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be x.

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (x × 4 × 5)/100

⇒ 20 x/100 = x/5

Amount = P + S.I

⇒ 4260 = x + x/5

⇒ 6 x/5 = 4260

⇒ x = 3550

Simple interest on the same sum for 4(1)/(5) years at the rate of 8(1)/(2)% p.a. is,

S.I = (3550 × 8(1)/(2) × 4(1)/(5) )/100

⇒ (3550 × 17/2 × 21/5)/100

⇒ 1267.35 ≈ 1267.

**∴ The Required Simple Interest is Rs. 1267. **
